text: 阿联酋央行表示，在美国财政部采取行动、切断这家埃及银行阿联酋分行与美国金融体系的联系（作为对伊朗制裁的一部分）后，该行将对埃及银行（Banque Misr）展开调查。阿联酋央行在一份声明中表示，已“决定对该行在美国周五公告中所涉两年多期间的交易进行特别紧急检查”。其调查“包括对美国当局声明中所涉期间的回溯性法证/深度审查，重点关注声明中提及的公司的银行交易”。
text_en: The UAE central bank said it will investigate Banque Misr after US Treasury action cut off the Egyptian bank's UAE branch from the US financial system as part of Iran sanctions. The UAE central bank said in a statement it had "decided to conduct a special urgent examination of the bank's transactions during the period of more than two years covered by the US Friday announcement." Its probe "includes a retroactive forensic/deep review of the period covered by the US authorities' statement, with focus on bank transactions involving companies named in the statement."
